whyUs.title: Why choose KTM Kawadi
whyUs.subtitle: Selling scrap should not feel like a gamble.
whyUs.fairBody: Our rates are published and updated openly. You know the number before we arrive.
whyUs.weighBody: Calibrated scales, visible readings, and no deductions invented at the last minute.
whyUs.freeBody: No transport charge, no minimum quantity fee, no charge for carrying it down the stairs.
whyUs.cashBody: Paid immediately, in full, before we leave. No IOUs and no follow-up calls.
whyUs.greenBody: Batteries and e-waste go to proper handlers, not into a landfill outside the city.
whyUs.localBody: A Kathmandu team you can call directly — not a call centre or an app queue.

about.title: About KTM Kawadi
about.subtitle: A Kathmandu scrap-buying service built on honest weighing and fair rates.
about.storyBody1: Selling scrap in Kathmandu has long been a game of guesswork. Rates are quoted from memory, scales are hidden, and the number agreed on the phone is rarely the number paid at the door. Most people accept it because there is no obvious alternative.
about.storyBody2: KTM Kawadi exists to remove that guesswork. We publish our rates openly, weigh everything in front of the customer, and pay the agreed amount in cash before we leave. Nothing about that is complicated — it is simply how the trade should have worked all along.
about.missionBody: To make recycling the easy, obvious choice for every household and business in Kathmandu Valley — by paying fairly, showing up reliably, and making sure what we collect is genuinely recycled rather than quietly dumped.
about.value1Body: Published rates, visible scales, and no deductions invented on arrival.
about.value2Body: If we agree a time, we come. If we cannot make it, we call you before the slot, not after.
about.value3Body: We carry, load and clean up. Your stairwell and your neighbours are left as we found them.
about.value4Body: Batteries and e-waste go to registered handlers. Nothing we collect ends up in a river or a roadside pile.
about.trustTitle: Why people keep calling us back
about.trustSub: Repeat customers are the only marketing that matters in this trade.
about.trust1: The rate quoted on the phone is the rate paid at the door.
about.trust2: Weighing happens where you can see it, every single time.
about.trust3: No charge for pickup, stairs, or loading — ever.
about.trust4: One local number, answered by people who do the work.
